Subject: Hosted API pilot pricing proposal (Medcen)

Hi Amira / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. The Medcen team is a great fit for the hosted API pilot we discussed (clinical notes ingestion → structured summarization). They committed to a three-month pilot with clear expansion signals to an enterprise rollout across their clinical product line if latency/accuracy and cost targets are met.

Quick ask: to accelerate the pilot and land the initial PO this quarter they requested a deeper than-normal introductory discount — specifically a 24% reduction to standard hosted token usage rates for the first 12 months paired with a minimum monthly commit of $10k during that period. They emphasized speed to production and the ability to move to Dedicated or Private later.

I've attached a draft SOW and a simple pricing cadence worksheet (see attachments). From a sales perspective this secures a high-probability expansion motion and an early case study in a top-20 health system.

Can we confirm whether we have executive flexibility to go to ~24% and, if so, what gating conditions we should require (term, MRR commit, programmatic checkpoints)? If not, what's the ceiling we should offer so I can get back to them this afternoon?

Thanks —
Ben

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Hosted API pilot pricing proposal (Medcen) — finance impact

Team —

Reviewed the attached pricing model. Key points:
- Baseline blended hosted token unit cost (our avg served across tenants): $0.0026/token.
- Medcen's requested 24% concession pushes effective unit revenue to ~$0.00198/token.
- With their projected pilot volume (est. 45M tokens/month ramping to 120M over 12 months), margin at 24% is borderline (~12% gross margin) before accounting for prefix cache benefits.

Recommendations:
1) Approve up to 22% off list rates for 12 months only, conditional on a signed 12-month minimum commitment of $120k/month (or a prepay equivalent). That maintains ~18% gross margin at projected volumes and keeps downside limited.
2) Include quarterly business reviews tied to quality/regression checks and a contractual right to revert pricing to list if usage pattern deviates from forecast by >25%.
3) No data residency or unusual SLA exceptions without legal signoff — add a surcharge if Private deployment is requested.

If Sales needs a higher concession (23–25%) I need a clear trade (longer term commit, higher prepay or a narrower token definition).

Mina Haddad
VP Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Hosted API pilot pricing proposal (Medcen) — legal notes

Quick legal notes:
- The SOW in the attachment is fine as a pilot draft. I recommend adding a clause that ties the discounted rate to the specific product/endpoint names and the agreed-upon token accounting method to avoid later ambiguity.
- We should avoid open-ended residency or IP concessions. If Medcen requires Private deployment or additional data handling terms, add a pass-through surcharge and a 10–14 day security assessment window.
- DocuSign: do not execute anything until commercial terms (discount + commit) are documented in a signed amendment to the standard MSA.

I'll prepare a one-page amendment template for discounted pilots that includes the revert clause Mina suggested and a monthly usage reconciliation process.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

Subject: Requesting senior approval — Medcen Labs (24% ask)

Markus —

Ben has an inbound from Medcen Labs that could convert quickly to a meaningful enterprise engagement. They are requesting a 24% concession to hosted token pricing for the first 12 months with a minimum monthly commit of $10k. Finance and legal recommended a 22% ceiling without stronger commit/prepay.

Why this matters:
- Fast pilot with high expansion signal (two product teams lined up, internal champions, pilot has executive sponsorship).
- Strategic reference in a large health-system cluster — potential to drive material PR and future demand from their partner network.

Ask: Can we authorize a one-time conditional approval to go up to 25% off list for the first 12 months provided the customer signs a 12-month minimum commitment at $120k/month effective immediately or prepay equal to 6 months, includes the revert clause and quarterly quality checkpoints, and excludes any residency/IP concessions? If yes, we'll push the PO today and route the amendment via DocuSign.

I've attached the pricing model again and a short bullet list of gating conditions to be included in the amendment.

Thanks —
Karthik

Subject: Re: Requesting senior approval — Medcen Labs (24% ask)

Folks —

Approved with conditions. Greenlight to offer up to a 25% concession off hosted list rates for the first 12 months only under the following mandatory terms:
1) Signed 12-month minimum commitment of $120k/month OR 6-month prepaid equivalent received before pilot start.
2) Discount is tied to the listed Hosted API endpoints and the explicit token accounting method documented in the amendment. No backdating or catch-all language.
3) Quarterly technical & quality checkpoints with the option to revert to list pricing if usage deviates >25% from forecast or if evals show regressions impacting agreed SLAs.
4) No changes to our standard IP/residency posture; any request for Private deployment or bespoke data handling triggers a surcharge and an additional legal/security approval.
5) CFO (Mina) to confirm final margin math at the time of signature; legal (Marissa) to finalize the amendment language and DocuSign packet.

Karthik/Ben — proceed to accept Medcen's PO subject to the conditions above and get the signed amendment executed. Please copy me on the DocuSign envelope.

-Markus Klein
